scope: External-input backtest; separate from BLS Table 6/7 contribution accounting and not read by UI.

sample.input_transform: EIA daily/weekly values are averaged to months then transformed to MoM. BLS industry PPI inputs are used as published (NSA) MoM with calendar-month fixed effects; they are not relabelled as seasonally adjusted.
sample.vintage_policy: Current source vintages are collected. The model is time-ordered and has no target look-ahead in its training windows, but an archival release-vintage panel is not yet retained. Results therefore cannot activate a pathway.

fred.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
fred.provenance_note: PCU311311 and PCU484484 are BLS PPI industry series retrieved through FRED because the BLS Public Data API rejected those configured identifiers on the first live run.

local_public_fallback.note: When API credentials are absent, the same public series are retrieved through FRED CSV; GitHub automation continues to use Secrets when present.

reasons: This first pass uses current-revised histories, not an archival release-vintage panel.
Conditional predictive tests and OOS comparisons do not establish causality.
Specified demand/capacity/hedging and supply-chain confounders are not fully observed in this first pass.

specification.baseline: target AR(1), lagged common-factor controls and calendar-month fixed effects
specification.extended: baseline plus all pre-specified external distributed lags
specification.availability_rule: The contemporaneous EIA daily input is aggregated over the reference month and is available before the following-month CPI release; industrial production is lagged one month because its release can follow the CPI release.

target.interpretation: diagnostic_only; differenced MoM inputs are used regardless of these finite-sample tests

jet_fuel_us_gulf_coast_spot.interpretation: diagnostic_only; differenced MoM inputs are used regardless of these finite-sample tests

conditional_predictive_test.method: joint HAC Wald test of external distributed-lag block conditional on AR(1), common-factor control and calendar-month fixed effects
conditional_predictive_test.interpretation: conditional predictive content only; not causality or a forecast signal

limitations: Model selection across lag candidates can overstate a single best lag; the reported best individual coefficient is exploratory.

CPI is SA, but the two configured industry PPI indexes are NSA; the first pass keeps those inputs as published and absorbs recurring calendar seasonality with month fixed effects. It is not a substitute for an official PPI seasonal adjustment.
COVID-era structural changes, airline hedging, seat capacity, agricultural commodity inputs, retail margins, and revision vintages can change the apparent relationship.

pre-specified out-of-sample improvement versus autoregressive benchmark
coefficient direction stability outside COVID-era sensitivity windows

limitations: No source credential, raw request URL, or credential-bearing payload is persisted in this snapshot.
Current-vintage source histories do not recreate the exact information set available on each historical release date.
Results are research diagnostics only and must not change the CPI relationship catalog's candidate status.
